title: Text tabs
description: Big display tabs (`font-display text-tab-xl`, 24px below sm / 28px from sm, weight 400) for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page: every tab in strong text colour, inactive at opacity 0.2 (raised on hover in 150ms), active with a 2px brand underline at 6px offset under the word only.
when: 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page, rendered as the page heading (Khám phá / Mẫu sẵn / Cảm hứng).
Views people link to or reload into: pass `href` on each item or keep `?tab=` with `useTabParam`.

instead.need: 5+ sections of one page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages)
2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts
Sections of one record inside a card or dialog

a11y: WAI-ARIA tabs: tablist / tab / tabpanel, ←/→, Home and End move and the current tab is the only tab stop.
Buttons switch as focus moves (or wait for Enter / Space with `activation="manual"`); linked tabs (`href`) move focus on arrows and navigate on Enter or Space.
`onBeforeChange` guards both button tabs and `href` link tabs (sync boolean or Promise<boolean>).
Inactive tabs use `text-strong` at `opacity-20` (explicit owner exception for the 24–28px display tab heading; hover raises opacity, keyboard `:focus-visible` restores full contrast).
notes: Only for 2–4 sub-pages. For 5+ sections or sections with icons, use `PillTabs`.
Weight is 400 (`font-normal`) in `font-display`: never force 600–800 bold on top of a heavy display face.
Gaps are 16 / 20 / 24px (`base` / `sm` / `md`) with 28px from the tab row to the intro text below.

examples.title: Page heading with intro and panel
